Optimal.Notes: The game runs at a rock-solid 60 fps at full native resolution and high settings within a modest TDP budget; this is the recommended everyday profile for the best visual fidelity and comfortable session length.

profiles.Summary: Darkest Dungeon is a 2D gothic indie RPG with very modest hardware requirements, running natively well within the Steam Deck's capabilities and holding a smooth 60 fps with minimal power draw. It is Steam Deck Verified and runs excellently under Proton with no significant compatibility issues reported.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the game's very lightweight PC minimum requirements (OpenGL 3.2, 2 GB RAM) and its 2D art engine — on first run, confirm the frame rate is stable at 60 fps and reduce TDP further if battery life is the priority.

MaxBattery.Notes: This 2D game is extremely light on GPU and CPU; a 4 W TDP and low GPU clock are more than sufficient to hold 30 fps and maximise battery life. In-game graphics options are minimal — names are estimated from typical Unity-era indie titles of this type.

KnownIssues: Partial controller support may require some UI navigation with touchscreen or mouse for certain menus.
Text and UI elements can appear small at native resolution on the Deck's 7-inch screen.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Settings are identical to Optimal because the game is already GPU/CPU-light and fully maxed out at 60 fps; the higher TDP headroom ensures zero throttling even during loading and ensures the system stays responsive during long dungeon runs.

Optimal.Notes: The game runs effortlessly at 60 fps with all settings maxed at a low TDP; this profile gives the best visual experience with good battery life. No upscaling is needed given the game's 2D nature and low rendering overhead.

profiles.Summary: Darkest Dungeon is a lightweight 2D gothic roguelike RPG with very modest PC requirements, and it runs excellently on the Steam Deck with Proton. The game's 2D art style and low GPU demands mean the Deck can drive it at full resolution and high settings with minimal power draw.
profiles.BasisNote: No specific Steam Deck player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the game's very lightweight 2D PC requirements (minimum 2 GB RAM, OpenGL 3.2) and the Deck hardware. On your first run, confirm the game holds 60 fps at the Optimal profile — it almost certainly will, and you can then push to 90 Hz if desired.

MaxBattery.Notes: This 2D game is so light that even 4 W TDP is ample; the 30 fps cap and locked low GPU clock stretch the battery to its maximum. In-game graphics options are minimal in this title — these represent the available toggles; actual visual difference is negligible.

KnownIssues: Partial controller support may mean some UI elements or menus are better navigated with the touchscreen or touchpad rather than the analog stick.
No native Linux build; runs via Proton, though ProtonDB reports it at platinum with no major issues.
Some players report small text in certain menus that can be hard to read at 1280x800 on the Deck screen.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Darkest Dungeon is light enough to hit 90 Hz on the OLED Deck without breaking a sweat; all settings maxed at 90 fps is fully realistic. The higher TDP and GPU clock are precautionary — the game will likely use far less in practice.
